name: magdev/php-assimp
scope: One mesh with three vertices and one face reported from a valid local ASCII PLY triangle
family: Assimp native PLY loader through magdev/php-assimp CLI wrapper
family_note: The PHP 0.3.2 package invokes the external Assimp 6.0.6 CLI and returns its format-aware info output. It is a distinct PHP package path but shares Assimp PLY parsing with C/C++ paths. Version 0.6.0 is separately recorded as failing.
